name: t2-sentiment-agent-agent-hub
description: Bitget Agent Hub CLI (bgc), pinned for t2-sentiment-agent. Install with `npm ci --ignore-scripts`; the agent runs it as `node node_modules/@bitget-ai/bitget-agent-cli/lib/index.js`. Both packages are pinned to the exact 3.0.0 release whose source was read for this project (agent-sdk/src/client/rest-client.ts:274-280 sends paptrading: 1 on private calls; execution/environment.py re-checks the installed file).
